## Rule

**Frame-raycast-crop** (decoded 2026-06-01 from ARC-GEN generator `task_5daaa586` + ≥10 pairs):

1. **Frame** = the two fully-nonzero rows (`r0<r1`) and two fully-nonzero cols (`c0<c1`)
   — "fully nonzero" across the actual grid width, NOT same-color. They bound a rectangle.
2. **Crop** = the inclusive rect `[r0..r1] × [c0..c1]`, re-emitted shifted to `(0,0)`.
3. The strict **interior** holds "markers" — nonzero cells, all of one color `M`.
4. `M` matches exactly ONE frame side (the side whose border color == `M`).
5. **Every** interior marker casts a ray of color `M` toward that side, filling interior
   background cells from the marker up to (not incl.) the frame. Rays merge.

> ⚠️ **`prototypes/task138_numpy_reference.py` IS BUGGY** — it `break`s after the FIRST interior
> marker, so it rays only one cell. The real rule (and LIVE) rays ALL markers. Do NOT use that
> numpy ref as an oracle. Use ARC-GEN ground truth (`ng_gate truth`) — the independent generator.
> Verified: every interior marker is the same color `M`, and exactly one frame side carries `M`
> (gated by "M appears >1× on the border" so a coincidental corner doesn't false-trigger).

Geometric bounds from the generator (PROVEN, see floor proof): `width=randint(10,25)`,
`height=width±1` ⇒ **input ≤ 26×25**; crop ⇒ **≤ 24 tall × 23 wide**.

## Algorithm sketch (minimal ONNX rewrite, v6 = 15,510)

```
canvas  = Conv(input, [0..9] on (0,0) tap, dilations=[4,4])      # dilated crop-collapse -> [1,1,26,26] color idx (§8b)
frame   = ReduceSum/Einsum(input) over ch+row/col -> full rows/cols ; ArgMax(desc/asc) -> r0,r1,c0,c1
shifted = Gather(Gather(Pad(canvas,sentinel10), r0+range), c0+range)   # 2-step shift, out-of-crop -> sentinel
mvals   = Where(interior, shifted, 0)                            # interior markers ; M = ReduceMax(mvals)
extremes= ArgMax(mvals, per-col/row, first/last)                # topmost/botmost/leftmost/rightmost  (tiny [1,26])
gates   = (M appears >1 on each border line of `shifted`)        # which side matches -> ray direction
fill_v  = Greater(signed_row > gated_vbound) ; fill_h = Greater(signed_col > gated_hbound)   # ONE compare per axis
base    = Where(fill_v|fill_h, M, shifted)                       # paint rays
output  = Equal(Pad(base -> 30x30, sentinel10), [0..9])          # free Equal-expand -> BOOL [1,10,30,30]
```

Key cost ideas (vs LIVE's 4 MaxPool rays + INT64 ArgMax canvas): (a) **bound-gating at the tiny
`[1,26]` extreme level** so each axis is a single `Greater` on the big plane — no per-direction
`AND`/`MaxPool` on `[1,26,26]`; (b) capped signed-range removes the `interior` AND from the fill;
(c) sentinel-gather removes the `inside` mask; (d) the final `Equal` IS the free graph output.

### Floor proof (why <1k is structurally impossible; floor = 13,204)

- **Dominating tensor**: the per-cell **color canvas** `canv4` [1,1,25,24] F32 = **2,400 B** (v9;
  the gather-source min size). The rule's output is the cropped grid re-emitted as a one-hot, so
  every output cell needs its source COLOR; the only way to read per-cell color from the
  `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot input is to collapse
  the channel axis (Conv/Einsum weighted by `[0..9]`) or ArgMax. **ORT forces Conv/Einsum out dtype
  = in dtype = F32** (input is F32, fixed by the NeuroGolf encoder). An F16/U8 canvas needs a
  full-input Cast (`[1,10,*,*]` = 18,000/9,000) or ArgMax-over-channels (INT64 = 7,200) — all
  larger. Same documented irreducible-canvas floor as `Onnx_Advanced/techniques.md §8b` (task400).
  **2,704 > 1,000 alone ⇒ <1k impossible** for any approach that re-emits per-cell colors — which
  this rule fundamentally requires.
- **The rule MANDATES, each a distinct 26×26-scale plane that cannot be fused away**:
  (a) the color canvas (above); (b) a **data-dependent 2D crop-shift** to origin — the frame sits
  at `(r0,c0)≠(0,0)` and the output is the crop at `(0,0)`; a static `Slice` with computed starts
  yields dynamic shapes that `calculate_memory`'s `infer_shapes(strict_mode)` rejects → cost `None`
  (traps §8c / §8b note), so the shift MUST be 2 `Gather`s with computed index vectors (+ sentinel
  pad so out-of-crop decodes to all-zero padding); (c) **marker localization** — an interior-masked
  color plane is the ArgMax source for the per-col/row extremes; (d) a **2D directional flood** —
  fundamentally a cumulative/extreme operation (ArgMax-extreme here), NOT a shape-op, so it cannot
  reach the ~1.5k pure-Slice/Gather floor.
- **No reformulation removes these**: one-hot space makes every plane 10× (`[1,10,*,*]`);
  per-channel shifts are 10 gathers; the flood needs a real 2D propagation. The levers pulled:
  rank-4 (no reshape, v7); §8b dilated crop-collapse to the **generator-proven** sizes — canvas
  `[1,1,25,24]`, crop planes `[1,1,24,23]` (input ≤26×25, crop ≤24×23, proven from `randint` + 230k
  samples, v9). The one remaining structural lever (negative-pad-crop canvas row0/col0, v10) was
  REJECTED: byte-equal on-contract but trips the off-contract adversarial probe (see Don't-do).
- **Verdict**: floor = 13,204 (v9) at the discipline bar (visible + 200k truth + 100% adversarial).
  Not "tried smaller, didn't help" — the 2,400 canvas is forced by F32-output ONNX semantics, the 12
  dependent planes are each required by a distinct non-fusible step, and the only sub-13,204 idea
  (v10, 12,899) sacrifices adversarial robustness for 305 B. **Safety ladder by assumption count:
  v9 13,204 (crop ≤24×23, 100% adv) → v7 14,838 (N=26, SHIPPED +1.38) → v5 17,525 (N=30, ZERO crop
  assumption).** All staged-quality (200k/200k truth).

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._

- Do NOT pre-crop the input to [1,10,N,N] for task138. The active grid can be positioned anywhere in the 30×30 field (first_row can be > 0), so pre-cropping loses cells. Instead use range-reduction crop (change frc_range30 to N elements) to reduce post-Gather tensors.
- Do NOT change frc_c29 when applying range-reduction crop: it must stay at 29 to clamp gather indices to the 30-row input bounds, not the N-element output bounds.
- Do NOT change frc_row_grid, frc_col_grid, frc_desc_row/col, frc_asc_row/col when applying range-reduction crop: these are used for bbox detection on the original 30×30 grid and must stay at 30 elements.
- MaxPool nodes need NO changes when doing range-reduction crop to N=26: with kernel=30, pads=[0,0,29,0], output_size = (26+0+29-30)+1 = 26. Correct output preserved.
- Do NOT try to eliminate frc_crop_nz by reordering multiplications: Mul(frc_crop, frc_nonzero_oh) and Mul(frc_crop_nz, frc_interior) are sequential [1,10,26,26] → any reordering (e.g. Mul(frc_nonzero_oh, frc_interior) first) still produces a [1,10,26,26] intermediate — same cost.
- Do NOT try bool-first on Phase A/B/C intermediates: frc_active, frc_nz, frc_row_* are [1,1,30,1] or [1,1,30,30] (60–1800 bytes each). Total savings ~3k bytes vs complexity cost.
- Do NOT try to eliminate the 5 crop-sized [1,10,26,26] tensors (frc_crop, frc_crop_nz, frc_marker_cells, frc_delta, output_active) with the current one-hot algorithm. Both frc_marker_any (axis=1 reduction → spatial) and frc_marker_oh_count (axes=[2,3] reduction → per-channel) require the full [1,10,26,26] materialization — they can't be computed from smaller projections without fundamentally changing the representation. A color-index (ArgMax) redesign could save ~40-60k bytes but requires rewriting ~60 nodes and managing careful dtype handling.
- After radical_v1: minimum cost with current algorithm architecture is ~130-140k bytes. Getting below 60k requires color-index rewrite (complex, risky).
- In a color-index rewrite, do NOT compute marker color with `ReduceSum(shifted_idx * marker_mask)`: there can be multiple interior marker cells of the same color, so summing turns color 2 repeated six times into 12 and disables all side gates. Use presence logic / `ReduceMax` over the masked color-index cells.
- For exact full-tensor parity, outside-crop cells must be channel-all-zero, not background channel 0. In color-index output, set outside-crop indices to out-of-range 10 before the final one-hot/equal expansion.

### 2026-06-01 drive-to-floor rewrite — don't-dos / gotchas

- **Do NOT trust `task138_numpy_reference.py`** — it `break`s after the first interior marker so it
  rays only one cell; the real rule rays ALL markers. It would NOT pass 266/266. Oracle = ARC-GEN
  truth (`ng_gate truth`), never that numpy ref.
- **Do NOT use MaxPool rays** (LIVE did, 4× `[1,1,N,N]` F16 = 5,408 B + per-direction gating on big
  planes). Instead get per-col/row marker EXTREMES via `ArgMax(select_last_index=0/1)` (tiny `[1,N]`)
  and gate the BOUNDS at that tiny level → each axis fill is ONE signed `Greater` on the big plane.
  Much cheaper gating. The fill is then `signed_range > gated_bound` where `signed_range = dir*range`
  flips `>`/`<` by direction (bottom-match `+r > topmost`; top-match `-r > -botmost ≡ r < botmost`).
- **Do NOT keep the `bg ∧ interior` restriction on the fill** — interior cells are only {bg, M}, so
  painting a marker cell `M→M` is a no-op. `fill = reach ∧ interior` (or, with capped signed-range,
  `reach` alone) suffices. Saved 2 big planes.
- **Do NOT add an `inside` mask + final Where for outside-crop** — instead Pad the canvas with a
  sentinel (10) and route out-of-crop gather indices to the sentinel row/col; `shifted` then already
  carries 10 outside the crop and the free `Equal([0..9])` makes those cells all-zero padding.
- **Do NOT clamp shift indices** (`Min(r0+rng,29)`): for in-crop rows `r0+rng ≤ r1 ≤ 29` always, and
  out-of-crop indices are overwritten by the sentinel `Where` — the clamp is dead weight.
- **ORT dtype traps hit during this rewrite**: `Mul(uint8,uint8)` → INVALID_GRAPH (use `Where` for
  the interior-mask multiply); `ReduceSum(uint8)` unsupported (gate-count Cast to F16, not U8);
  `ReduceMax` at opset 13 takes `axes` as an ATTRIBUTE (unlike `ReduceSum`, which takes it as a 2nd
  INPUT at opset 13). `ArgMax/ReduceMax/MaxPool/Greater/Where/Equal/Gather(idx)/Pad` all OK on U8.
- **Dilated crop-collapse double-count gotcha**: `Conv→[1,1,N,N] F32` then `Reshape→[1,N,N] F32`
  materializes the F32 canvas TWICE (2,704×2). **Cast to U8 BEFORE the reshape** so the reshape
  duplicate is a cheap 676-B U8, not a 2,704-B F32. (cost 17,538→15,510.)
- **Crop bound is generator-PROVEN, not sampled**: `width=randint(10,25)`, `height=width±1`,
  `crop=(right-left+1,down-up+1)` with `right≤width-2,left≥1,down≤height-2,up≥1` ⇒ input ≤26×25,
  crop ≤24×23. v5 (17,525, N=30) is the zero-assumption fallback if the bound is ever distrusted —
  but 200k/200k truth confirms the tighter sizes on the real generator.

### 2026-06-02 sub-14,838 push (after v7 shipped +1.38 LB)

- **Canvas size ≠ crop-plane size — they have DIFFERENT minima.** The crop planes (shift OUTPUT)
  hold the crop ≤24 rows × 23 cols → `[1,1,24,23]`. But the canvas (gather SOURCE) must cover input
  rows `up..down` and cols `left..right`; since `down≤24, right≤23`, it needs rows 0..24 (25) ×
  cols 0..23 (24) → `[1,1,25,24]`, ONE larger than the crop in each constrained dim. Sizing both at
  a single N (as v6/v7 did) over-pays. Split them: v7 14,838 → v8 (square crop 24) 13,434 → v9
  (asym crop 24×23) 13,204. Use per-axis sentinels (`SENT_row=CANVAS_H`, `SENT_col=CANVAS_W`).
- **DON'T negative-pad-crop the canvas row0/col0 (v10), even though `up,left≥1` makes them unused.**
  It works on-contract (v10 is BYTE-EQUAL to v9 on 2266 official-encoded inputs + 200k/200k truth)
  and saves 305 B (→12,899), BUT adversarial-vs-LIVE collapses (base 238/266, perturbations ~85%):
  the cropped canvas cannot represent a frame touching row/col 0, which the off-contract ch0=1 probe
  (and `shift` perturbation) creates. The real all-zero-padding pipeline never does this, so v10 is
  real-test-correct — but it forfeits the robustness margin the adversarial gate measures, for 0.023
  LB. Not worth it under the "visible + 200k + adversarial all-clean" discipline. (ORT DOES support
  negative Conv pads — verified — so the technique is sound; the rejection is about robustness, not
  feasibility.) Kept as `build_task138_v10.py`.
- **Audited and confirmed NON-reducible at the 13,204 floor**: both shift gathers (2-step 2D shift,
  the `shift_rows` intermediate is unavoidable — col-first ordering costs the same); `interior`+`mvals`
  (ArgMax needs the masked plane; nesting the Where doesn't cut the count); `fill_v`+`fill_h`+`reach`
  (two different-axis comparisons + union; nested-Where is the same count); `base_pad` `[1,1,30,30]`
